info.title: Agility CMS Universal API
info.description: Agility CMS is a headless CMS content fetch integration for retrieving pages, content models, lists, items, galleries, redirects, and sync feeds from Agility instances.

get.description: Retrieves a published content item from Agility CMS.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The contentID of the item to retrieve.

schema.description: The contentID of the item to retrieve.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
